# AIMehendi.in

> Free AI-powered mehendi (henna) design generator. Create bridal, Arabic, mandala, simple, and finger mehendi designs in seconds. Hinglish + Hindi content for Indian users.

AIMehendi.in lets users generate unlimited mehendi designs with AI, browse a curated gallery, and learn techniques through detailed Hinglish tutorials.

## Pages

- [Home](/): AI Mehendi Design Generator landing page with overview, gallery preview, and features.
- [Generate](/generate): Free AI tool to create custom mehendi designs (bridal, Arabic, mandala, simple, finger, back hand).
- [Gallery](/gallery): Browse 1000+ AI-generated mehendi designs across categories.
- [Blog](/blog): Hinglish tutorials, design guides, and festival mehendi inspiration.
- [About](/about): About AIMehendi.in, the team, and FAQs.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the AIMehendi.in team.

## Landing Pages

- [Bridal Mehendi Design 2026](/bridal-mehendi-design-2026): Latest bridal/dulhan mehendi designs for 2026.
- [Karwa Chauth Mehndi Design](/karwa-chauth-mehndi-design): Special Karwa Chauth mehendi patterns.

## Gallery Categories

- [Bridal Gallery](/gallery/bridal): Bridal mehendi designs.
- [Arabic Gallery](/gallery/arabic): Arabic mehendi designs.

- [Simple Gallery](/gallery/simple): Simple/everyday mehendi designs.
- [Finger Gallery](/gallery/finger): Finger mehendi designs.
- [Festival Gallery](/gallery/festival): Festival mehendi designs (Diwali, Karwa Chauth, Raksha Bandhan).
